name: Foothill Ranch Towne Centre
description: Foothill Ranch Towne Centre is a convenient community shopping destination located in the heart of Foothill Ranch, offering a diverse mix of dining, shopping, and service options. The center serves the surrounding residential communities with everyday conveniences and popular retailers in an accessible open-air format. With its prime location along Portola Parkway, it provides a neighborhood-focused shopping experience for Orange County residents.
summary: A community-focused shopping center in Foothill Ranch offering dining, shopping, and essential services for Orange County residents.
